description_en: Queries the line chart of the bills for the burstable QPS of an Anti-DDoS Proxy instance
description_zh: 查询DDoS高防实例弹性QPS账单曲线图
name: DescribeElasticQps

parameters.help_en:
The type of the service. Valid values:

cn: Anti-DDoS Proxy (Chinese Mainland)
cn-hongkong: Anti-DDoS Proxy (Outside Chinese Mainland)
parameters.help_zh:
服务地域。取值：
cn：中国内地。
cn-hongkong：非中国内地
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the Anti-DDoS Proxy instance to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS高防实例的IP地址
parameters.name: ip

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

This UNIX timestamp must indicate a point in time that is accurate to the minute
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

This UNIX timestamp must indicate a point in time that is accurate to the minute
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The sampling interval. Unit: seconds. The value must be a multiple of 60. Default value: 60. Unit: seconds. The query result varies depending on the sampling interval
parameters.help_zh: 采样间隔，单位：秒。必须是60秒的倍数，默认60s。返回结果可缩放
parameters.name: interval
